translationRepairs: He dispatched Palace Attendant Yan Xie, bearing imperial tallies, to mobilize troops from Kuaiji and sail by sea to rescue them.
He dispatched Palace Grandee Yan Zhu, bearing imperial tallies, to mobilize troops from Kuaiji and sail by sea to rescue them.
嚴助 is Yan Zhu, not Yan Xie; 中大夫 is Palace Grandee, not Palace Attendant. Literal field may carry the same error.
In the fourth month of summer, Lord Pingyuan passed away.
In the fourth month of summer, Lady Pingyuan passed away.
平原君 here is Zang Er, the female mother of the Empress Dowager; "Lord" misgenders her.

In the sixth month of summer, Imperial Secretary Han Anguo was made Protector General, Guard Commander Li Guang was made Brave Cavalry General, Master of Carriages Gongsun He was made Light Chariot General, Grand Herald Wang Hui was made Army Encampment General, and Palace Grandee Li Xi was made Timber Officer General. They led a force of 300,000 men stationed in the valley of Maiyi to lure the Chanyu and ambush him.

In the sixth month of summer, Imperial Secretary Han Anguo was made Protector General, Guard Commander Li Guang was made Brave Cavalry General, Master of Carriages Gongsun He was made Light Chariot General, Grand Herald Wang Hui was made Army Encampment General, and Palace Grandee Li Xi was made Timber Officer General. They led a force of 300,000 men stationed in the valley of Mayi to lure the Chanyu and ambush him.
馬邑 is read Mayi, not Maiyi.
The Eastern yiwei day lord Nan Lu and others, with twenty-eight myriads of people, surrendered. He established Cang Hai commandery.
Nan Lu, lord of the Hui among the Eastern Yi, and others, with twenty-eight myriads of people, surrendered. He established Cang Hai commandery.
東夷薉君 means the lord of the Hui (薉) among the Eastern Yi; "yiwei day" is a mistranslation. Literal field may carry the same error.

In the first month of spring, he issued this edict: 'The King of Liang and King of Chengyang are intimate and benevolent, born of the same mother. They wish to divide their fief with their younger brother. Permit this.

In the first month of spring, he issued this edict: 'The King of Liang and King of Chengyang are intimate and benevolent, loving toward their siblings. They wish to divide their fief with their younger brother. Permit this.
親慈同生 means affectionate toward their full brothers, not that the two kings share a mother.
All fugitive debts and lawsuits from before the three years after Xiaojing's reign should not be heard or governed.'
All fugitive debts and lawsuits from before the third year of Houyuan of Emperor Xiaojing should not be heard or governed.'
孝景後三年 is Houyuan 3 of Emperor Jing, not "three years after Xiaojing's reign".
In the fourth month of summer, Wei Qing again led six generals beyond the screen, achieving great victories.
In the fourth month of summer, Wei Qing again led six generals across the desert, achieving great victories.
絕幕 means crossing the desert (幕 = 漠), not "beyond the screen". Literal field may carry the same error.
He dispatched Brave Cavalry General Huo Qubing from Longxi to Gaolan, where he beheaded over 8,000.
He dispatched General of Swift Cavalry Huo Qubing from Longxi to Gaolan, where he beheaded over 8,000.
驃騎將軍 is General of Swift Cavalry, distinct from 驍騎將軍 Brave Cavalry General.
In autumn, the Xiongnu's Kunye King killed Xiutu King and, combining their forces totaling over 40,000 people, came to surrender. He established five dependent states to settle them.
In autumn, the Xiongnu's Hunye King killed Xiutu King and, combining their forces totaling over 40,000 people, came to surrender. He established five dependent states to settle them.
昆邪王 is conventionally read Hunye King.

In winter of the fourth year, the relevant officials reported that poor people from Guandong had been moved to Longxi, Beidi, Xibe, Shangjun, and Kuaiji totaling 725,000 people. The county officials clothed and fed them, rescuing their livelihoods, but expenditures were insufficient. They requested collecting silver and tin to make white gold and leather coins to suffice for use.

In winter of the fourth year, the relevant officials reported that poor people from Guandong had been moved to Longxi, Beidi, Xihe, Shangjun, and Kuaiji totaling 725,000 people. The county officials clothed and fed them, rescuing their livelihoods, but expenditures were insufficient. They requested collecting silver and tin to make white gold and leather coins to suffice for use.
西河 is Xihe commandery, not Xibe.
On the yisi day of the fourth month of summer, in the temple he established Crown Prince Hong as King of Qi, Dan as King of Yan, and Xu as King of Guangling.
On the yisi day of the fourth month of summer, in the temple he established imperial son Hong as King of Qi, Dan as King of Yan, and Xu as King of Guangling.
皇子閎 means imperial son Hong; he was not crown prince. Literal field may carry the same error.
In the ninth month of autumn, Grand Commandant Brave Cavalry General Qubing passed away.
In the ninth month of autumn, Grand Marshal and General of Swift Cavalry Qubing passed away.
大司馬 is Grand Marshal and 驃騎將軍 is General of Swift Cavalry.
Will the common people find peace through different roads, while cunning officials take advantage of power to oppress the common masses?
Months have passed since the old coinage was abolished, yet the people of the mountains and marshes have not understood.
The English duplicates s0254; 廢期有月，而山澤之民未諭 means months have passed since the abolition, and the mountain and marsh people still do not understand.

The region south of the Yangzi employs fire farming and water cultivation methods. We are shipping grain from Ba and Shu to Jiangling, and have sent scholars and officials to travel throughout the area and proclaim to all destinations that they should not suffer additional burdens.

The region south of the Yangzi employs fire farming and water cultivation methods. We are shipping grain from Ba and Shu to Jiangling, and have sent the Erudite Zhong and others to travel throughout the area and proclaim to all destinations that they should not suffer additional burdens.
博士中等 means the Erudite Zhong and others, a named person.
Qing reached north of the screen and surrounded the Chanyu, beheading 19,000. He reached Tianyan Mountain and then returned.
Qing reached north of the desert and surrounded the Chanyu, beheading 19,000. He reached Tianyan Mountain and then returned.
幕北 means north of the desert (幕 = 漠).

In the tenth month of winter in the sixth year, cavalry from Longxi, Tianshui, and Anding along with the Capital Commandant were mobilized, plus 100,000 troops from Henan and Henei; Generals Li Xi and Yi were dispatched to campaign against the Western Qiang and pacified them.

In the tenth month of winter in the sixth year, cavalry from Longxi, Tianshui, and Anding along with the Capital Commandant were mobilized, plus 100,000 troops from Henan and Henei; General Li Xi and Chamberlain for Attendants Xu Ziwei were dispatched to campaign against the Western Qiang and pacified them.
郎中令一自為 is the Chamberlain for Attendants (Xu) Ziwei; "Yi" misreads the graph and drops the office. Literal field may carry the same error.

Departing from Yunyang, he traveled north through Shangdian, Xibe, and Wuyuan, passed beyond the Great Wall, ascended the Chanyu Terrace to the north, reached Shuofang, and overlooked the Northern River.

Departing from Yunyang, he traveled north through Shangdian, Xihe, and Wuyuan, passed beyond the Great Wall, ascended the Chanyu Terrace to the north, reached Shuofang, and overlooked the Northern River.
西河 is Xihe, not Xibe.
General of Sea Crossing Han Yue and Commandant Wang Wenshu were dispatched from Kuaiji, General of Tower Ships Yang Pu from Yuzhang, to attack them.
General of Sea Crossing Han Yue and Commandant of the Capital Wang Wenshu were dispatched from Kuaiji, General of Tower Ships Yang Pu from Yuzhang, to attack them.
中尉 is Commandant of the Capital.
General of Hidden Waves Lu Bode was sent from Guiyang, descending the Xiang River;
General of Hidden Waves Lu Bode was sent from Guiyang, descending the Huang River;
湟水 is the Huang River, not the Xiang.
General of Tower Ships Yang Pu departed from Yuzhang, descending the Qian River;
General of Tower Ships Yang Pu departed from Yuzhang, descending the Zhen River;
湞水 is the Zhen River, not the Qian.
General of Tower Ships Yang Pu and General of the Left Xun Xi were dispatched to lead recruited convicts against Joseon.
General of Tower Ships Yang Pu and General of the Left Xun Zhi were dispatched to lead recruited convicts against Joseon.
荀彘 is Xun Zhi; 彘 is read zhi. Literal field may carry the same error.
General of Tower Ships Yang Pu was convicted of excessive losses and desertions, demoted to commoner; General of the Left Xun Xi was convicted of disputing credit and executed in the marketplace.
General of Tower Ships Yang Pu was convicted of excessive losses and desertions, demoted to commoner; General of the Left Xun Zhi was convicted of disputing credit and executed in the marketplace.
荀彘 is Xun Zhi; 彘 is read zhi.
General Guo Chang and Colonel Wei Guang were also dispatched to raise troops from Ba and Shu to pacify the remaining unsubmissive Southwestern Yi, organizing them into Yizhou commandery.

General Guo Chang and Leader of Court Gentlemen Wei Guang were also dispatched to raise troops from Ba and Shu to pacify the remaining unsubmissive Southwestern Yi, organizing them into Yizhou commandery.
中郎將 is Leader of Court Gentlemen, not Colonel.
Upon reaching Huguzi and facing the breached river, he ordered all attending ministers and generals to carry firewood and block the river dikes, then composed the Huguzi song.
Upon reaching Huzi and facing the breached river, he ordered all attending ministers and generals to carry firewood and block the river dikes, then composed the Huzi song.
瓠子 is Huzi, not Huguzi.
The Xiongnu raided the border, so General Guo Chang was dispatched to station troops at Shuofang.
The Xiongnu raided the border, so General of Defeating the Hu Guo Chang was dispatched to station troops at Shuofang.
拔胡將軍 is the specific office General of Defeating the Hu, omitted in English.
In the tenth month of winter in the first year of Taiyuan, he traveled to Mount Tai.
In the tenth month of winter in the first year of Taichu, he traveled to Mount Tai.
太初 is the Taichu era, not Taiyuan. Literal field may carry the same error.
General Yin Huan was also dispatched from Xibe, and Cavalry Commandant Li Ling led 5,000 infantry from north of Juyan to fight the Chanyu, killing and capturing over 10,000.
The General of Yinyu was also dispatched from Xihe, and Cavalry Commandant Li Ling led 5,000 infantry from north of Juyan to fight the Chanyu, killing and capturing over 10,000.
因杅將軍 is the office General of Yinyu, not a person named Yin Huan; 西河 is Xihe.
In the first month of spring in the first year of Taishi, General Yin Huan Ao was convicted of crimes and sentenced to beheading.
In the first month of spring in the first year of Taishi, General of Yinyu Ao was convicted of crimes and sentenced to beheading.
因杅將軍 is the office General of Yinyu; Ao is Gongsun Ao.
In the fourth month of summer, he returned and performed the Feng sacrifice at Mount Tai and the Chan sacrifice at Shique.
In the fourth month of summer, he returned and performed the Feng sacrifice at Mount Tai and the Chan sacrifice at Shilü.
Chamberlain Xu Ziwei was dispatched to construct a line of cities beyond the Wuyuan frontier, extending northwest to Luqu, with General Han Yue leading troops to garrison them.
Superintendent of the Palace Xu Ziwei was dispatched to construct a line of cities beyond the Wuyuan frontier, extending northwest to Luqu, with General Han Yue leading troops to garrison them.
光祿勳 is the Superintendent of the Palace.
Bandits led by Xu Heng in Taishan and Langye blocked the mountain passes and attacked cities, making roads impassable.
Bandits led by Xu Bo in Taishan and Langye blocked the mountain passes and attacked cities, making roads impassable.
徐绗 (勃) is read Xu Bo.
On the yichou day, imperial son Fulian was established as Crown Prince.
On the yichou day, imperial son Fuling was established as Crown Prince.
弗陵 is read Fuling. Literal field may carry the same error.

On the renwu day, the Crown Prince and Empress plotted to execute Chong, raised troops using the imperial tally, and fought a major battle with Chancellor Liu Quji in Chang'an, with tens of thousands killed.

On the renwu day, the Crown Prince and Empress plotted to execute Chong, raised troops using the imperial tally, and fought a major battle with Chancellor Liu Qumao in Chang'an, with tens of thousands killed.
劉屈氂 is conventionally read Liu Qumao.
In the third month, General Guangli was dispatched with 70,000 troops from Wuyuan, Grandee Secretary Shangqiu Cheng with 20,000 from Xibe, and Marquis Ma Tong with 40,000 cavalry from Jiuquan.
In the third month, General Guangli was dispatched with 70,000 troops from Wuyuan, Grandee Secretary Shangqiu Cheng with 20,000 from Xihe, and Marquis Ma Tong with 40,000 cavalry from Jiuquan.
Grandee Secretary Bao Shengzhi and Director of Trials Tian Ren were convicted of dereliction of duty. Shengzhi committed suicide, Ren was sentenced to beheading.
Grandee Secretary Bao Shengzhi and Director of Rectitude Tian Ren were convicted of dereliction of duty. Shengzhi committed suicide, Ren was sentenced to beheading.
司直 is the Director of Rectitude (Chancellor's inspector), not Director of Trials.

Palace Attendant Commander Mang Heluo plotted rebellion with his younger brother, Marquis Chonghe Tong. They were suppressed by Palace Attendant Jin Midi, Carriage Commandant Huo Guang, and Cavalry Commandant Shangguan Jie.

Palace Attendant Commander Mang Heluo plotted rebellion with his younger brother, Marquis Chonghe Tong. They were suppressed by Palace Attendant and Commandant of Attendant Cavalry Jin Midi, Carriage Commandant Huo Guang, and Cavalry Commandant Shangguan Jie.
侍中駙馬都尉 includes the Commandant of Attendant Cavalry, omitted in English.
Now gold shall be renamed 'linyao lan ti' to harmonize with these auspicious omens.'
Now gold shall be renamed 'unicorn hooves and horse hooves' (linzhi niaoti) to harmonize with these auspicious omens.'
麟趾褭蹄 means unicorn-toe and horse-hoof shaped ingots, read linzhi niaoti.
With Emperor Wu's heroic talents and grand strategies, while maintaining the respectful frugality of Emperors Wen and Jing to benefit the people, what more could the Poetry and Documents praise!
With Emperor Wu's heroic talents and grand strategies, had he not abandoned the respectful frugality of Emperors Wen and Jing to benefit the people, what more could the Poetry and Documents praise!
不改文景之恭儉 is a counterfactual: had he not departed from the frugality of Wen and Jing; the English reads it as a fact.
